description: Maps a character pair to the per-relation-level item sets awarded as their relationship level rises.

ID.simple: Relationship reward row id (usually <character A>_<character B>).
ID.technical: FName member `Id` (the export writes the key as `ID` and declares ImportKeyField `Id`; all 44 exported keys equal it). MainMenuStory looks up GameManager.UserInfo.Story.StudioNameInts_7C0 by Reward->Id for the last granted level (default 1), writes ToLevel there with FindOrAdd only when a grant occurs, and puts the same Id into FGameStoryCorrelationDiagramRewardLevel records consumed by the earned-reward notify and list widgets. No studio-release flag gates this scan.

Id_Character_1.simple: First character of the rewarded pair.
Id_Character_1.technical: FName. The view widget accepts (1,2) or (2,1) before showing a row. MainMenuStory finds the StoryCharaGraphPair row keyed by this id, finds Id_Character_2 in Pair1->Id_Character, and uses that index for Pair1->StartRelateLevel[Index] and GetCharaRelateLevel(this, Id_Character_2); if the row or directed entry is absent that side stays at level 0. The earned-reward list item also resolves this id to a Character row/face icon and a directed relation label.

Id_Character_2.simple: Second character of the rewarded pair.
Id_Character_2.technical: FName; same unordered-pair selection as Id_Character_1. MainMenuStory repeats the GraphPair lookup from this id, finds Id_Character_1 in Pair2->Id_Character, and combines Pair2->StartRelateLevel[Index] and GetCharaRelateLevel(this, Id_Character_1) with the first direction (minimum current level, maximum start level). It also supplies the second character icon/relation label in the earned-reward item and both character-name parameters of the item-set unlock message.

Id_ItemSet.simple: ItemSet awarded at each relationship level.
Id_ItemSet.technical: TArray<FName>; every exported row has five slots. Slot 0 is `None` in all 44 rows and is not a level-1 reward: MainMenuStory calls GameShop_AddItemSetOnce(Id_ItemSet[Level - 1], 6) for Level = FromLevel+1..ToLevel, where FromLevel = max(saved grant level (default 1), both raw GraphPair start levels) and ToLevel = min(both directed current levels from GetCharaRelateLevel). No bounds check is done, so the five-slot shape and GraphPair end levels (3 or 5) bound the data. The reward view and earned level details read [ItemLevel - 1] for visible levels 2..5; the notify widget reads [Level] over the half-open [FromLevel, ToLevel) range (the same tiers, zero-based). `None` is the no-reward sentinel. Unlock text recovers the tier as the first Id_ItemSet.IndexOfByKey(Set->Id) + 1. All 130 non-None ids resolve in ItemSetDataTable; this row stores only their ids, not item contents or quantities.

notes: Granting is not gated by studio release or pair-release flags. UpdateCorrelationDiagram builds Released/New character and pair lists from StudioMissionInts_6D0/StudioNameInts_720 (state 1 becomes 2) for the diagram, then scans every StoryCharaRelateReward row; only the per-pair GraphPair start/current levels and the saved grant level decide grants (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:1066-1108, 1110-1164).

Reward levels are 1..5 and there is no level-1 item: slot 0 is `None` everywhere. The grant path defaults a missing saved level to 1 (StudioNameInts_7C0 has 0x80 slots) and only writes the new level when FromLevel < ToLevel; the reward view defaults the same saved level to 0 for its acquired check. A missing GraphPair row/directed entry leaves that side at level 0 in the grant scan and hides all milestones in the view (GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:1112-1114, 1152-1157; GameStoryCharaRelateRewardViewWidget.cpp:67-68, 71-77; GameUserStoryInfo.h:24).

GetCharaRelateLevel converts saved point changes through GlobalThreshold STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5 (Min 0/25/50/75/100), so the `Level` values in grant/notify loops are display levels, not raw points (Source/Abrams/Private/GameManagerGraphics.cpp:531-550; Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_WidgetTest.cpp:289-324).

Index precedence: MainMenuStory uses [Level - 1], the view/earned level details use [ItemLevel - 1]/[DetailLevel - 1], and the notify widget uses [Level] for Level = FromLevel..ToLevel-1 (the zero-based equivalent of the newly crossed levels). Unlock text considers only unlocked ItemSet rows and uses the first matching reward row, with VALUE = array index + 1 (GameStoryEarnedRewardNotifyWidget.cpp:133-139; GameShopSaleItemListItemDataBase.cpp:1748-1793).

Loading and lookup: DTM +0x8A0 is filled from the single StoryCharaRelateRewardDataTable primary asset via GameDataTableManager_ResolveLoadedTable/AddLoadedDataTables after all loaders complete; FGameDataTableArray::GetRows walks table order then row-name order, and FindRow-based consumers take the first match. The out-of-line row finder used by the earned-reward list is instantiated in StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:784 (retail 0x166ec40) (GameDataTableManager.cpp:162-176, 268; GameDataTableArray.h:19-35).

Exports: one full table with 44 rows and four fields (`ID`, `Id_Character_1`, `Id_Character_2`, `Id_ItemSet`); every row key equals `ID`, there are 44 unique unordered pairs, and all 130 non-None ItemSet ids resolve in ItemSetDataTable. Thirteen by-character derivative copies are subsets whose union adds no rows. All 16 character ids and both directed pair entries resolve in StoryCharaGraphPairDataTable, and every non-None tier matches the levels above the directed start and at or below the directed end.

Evidence is from reconstructed C++ in Source/ plus static exports. Retail RVAs in comments and status/ states show many consumers as `behavioural` (e.g. 0x167e9e0, 0x1688b20, 0x167fef0) with only some byte `match` rows (e.g. 0x1676f20); no retail Blueprint graph or live runtime was inspected. Widget-tree wiring (ItemWidget2..5, LevelDetail2..5) and the precise item-get notify semantics therefore remain reconstruction-based rather than retail-Blueprint-verified.

usages.detail: Flow-4 correlation-diagram update scans every reward row; for each it computes FromLevel = max(saved level, both GraphPair start levels) and ToLevel = min(both directed current levels), grants each crossed tier once with GetType 6, saves ToLevel and emits a RewardLevelChange.

Called by the relationship detail view; finds the row by unordered character pair, reads the saved grant level (default 0), and shows only GraphPair-defined milestone items (levels 2..5) with an acquired flag.
Looks the row up by RewardId through the out-of-line finder; uses both character ids for icons/relation labels and shows Id_ItemSet[DetailLevel - 1] for levels crossed in the one increase.
Creates one list-item data object per reward row as capacity, then fills only the RewardLevelChange entries supplied by the correlation diagram before refreshing the list.
Resolves each RewardLevelChange to the reward row and collects item categories from Id_ItemSet[Level] for Level = FromLevel..ToLevel-1 to select the notification messages and icons.

Reverse lookup for item unlock text: for unlocked ITM_SET_CHARA_RELATE_* sets it finds the first reward row containing the set, supplies both character names and the tier number (array index + 1), and returns ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0010.
Indirect consumer: opens the earned-reward notify and then the earned-reward list from the RewardLevelChanges produced by MainMenuStory.
Explicit StoryFindRowOutOfLine instantiation for this row type (retail 0x166ec40).
Loads StoryCharaRelateRewardDataTable into the cached StoryCharaRelateRewardDataTables array at DTM +0x8A0.
